problem.subtitle: Farmers don't just struggle with nature — they struggle with a rigged market that steals their hard-earned value.

cards.title: Middlemen Exploitation
cards.body: Farmers are forced to sell at rock-bottom prices to intermediaries who flip it to industry at 2x the price.

cards.title: No Direct Industry Access
cards.body: Factories, processing units & bulk buyers are unreachable for individual farmers without a network.

cards.title: Zero Price Transparency
cards.body: Farmers don't know what the market actually pays. Hidden rates keep them in the dark permanently.

cards.title: Months of Work, Minimal Return
cards.body: After an entire growing season, the final income doesn't reflect the labor or investment put in.

solution.subtitle: One platform. Zero middlemen. Full transparency. Shivar removes the middle layer and connects farmers directly to buyers.

cards.title: Farmer Listings
cards.body: Farmers upload crop details — type, quantity, location — and set their expected price or accept competitive bids from verified buyers.

cards.title: Industry Search & Bidding
cards.body: Factories and bulk buyers search by crop, region, and quantity. They contact farmers directly and place bulk orders — no phone tree, no broker.

cards.title: Smart Matching Engine
cards.body: Our AI suggests the best farmer-buyer pairs based on location proximity, demand patterns, and live price trends in the market.

cards.title: Live Price Transparency
cards.body: Every farmer can see what industries are actually paying today. No more guessing. No more manipulation. Just fair market data.

cards.title: Verified B2B Trust Layer
cards.body: Every buyer is verified. Every transaction is tracked. Farmers deal only with legitimate factories and certified buyers.

cards.title: Mobile-First, Low-Tech Friendly
cards.body: Built for rural India. Works on low-end smartphones, supports regional languages, with a UI any farmer can use in minutes.

cards.title: AI Crop Advisory
cards.body: Get instant, AI-driven guidance on soil health and crop suitability. Shivar verifies soil conditions and recommends what to grow, when to sow, and how to improve yield.

cards.title: Quality Transparency
cards.body: Farmers submit photos of their harvest and our AI analyzes crop quality automatically. Buyers can view the real photos themselves before placing a bid — no surprises, no disputes.

cards.title: Live Chat, Powered by Socket.io
cards.body: Real-time messaging between farmers and buyers lets both sides negotiate, confirm details, and close deals instantly — direct conversation, zero delay.

impact.subtitle: Shivar isn't just a product — it's a financial revolution for 58 million Indian farmers.

cards.title: Income Increase
cards.body: Direct access to buyers means farmers keep the profit that middlemen used to steal.

cards.title: Faster Selling
cards.body: Smart matching reduces the time from harvest to sale from weeks to hours.

cards.title: Price Transparency
cards.body: Every price is visible, every transaction tracked. Zero hidden cuts, ever.

cards.title: Crop Industries
cards.body: Works for cotton, wheat, sugarcane, soybean, pulses — scalable to every crop.
